title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 Publication Plan Work Item
summary: Add deterministic local publication-record generation for RFC 9461 DNS service bindings.
planned_changes:
- Add `DnsServiceBindingPublicationPlan` and publication-record rendering.
- Use existing operator guidance to decide whether an equivalent HTTPS record should be emitted.
- Render ServiceMode SVCB records through RFC 9461 Port Prefix Naming and validated scalar SvcParams.
- Reject invalid TargetName and TTL inputs.
- Add requirement-owned positive, negative, and edge tests.
- Update RFC 9461 trace artifacts, generated triage, and the requirement gap ledger.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused RFC 9461 publication planner requirement-home tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full local Release solution test before final goal completion.
out_of_scope: Platform router or forwarder advertisement adapters.
completion_notes: RFC 9461 now has a trace-owned deterministic publication-plan renderer for operator SVCB and equivalent HTTPS records.
